modules-for-signing-a-bundle.text: Dependency direction runs from the command line down to the shared library. Nothing here touches the write commands.

changed-responsibilities.text: The bundle module (shared local-services library, new) owns the bundle: its types, its JSON codec, the text envelopes of a transaction and of a witness, and the offline consistency check. It is pure: no files, no clock, no network, no age library.

ownership.text: Witness files belong to the command that writes them for the length of that command. Passphrase and key live in memory for one command. No state is kept.

not-changed.text: Fold, fold rules, preparation, session, lifecycle, the write commands, --wallet-skey, the vault format.
